Times: Tuesday from START-LIST-TUESDAY.pdf (printed on the first heat of each group = heat time; later heats of the group = group block start); Wednesday and Thursday from the organiser's revised schedules on news.php (block starts; the 20 June start-list times are superseded); finals from 2-Finals.pdf (heat times; that PDF says 'Saturday 23rd of June', the finals were Saturday 25 June per news.php and the result printouts); K1SM final ride 3 uses the printed per-boat Startzeit.
